sources.title: Individual income tax returns: Congressional district data, tax year 2023
sources.notes: Totals from individual income tax returns (Form 1040) filed during the following calendar year. The IRS assigns returns to districts by the ZIP code on the return. Amounts are published in thousands of dollars. This is not all federal tax: employer payroll taxes, corporate, excise, and estate taxes are not published by congressional district.
